column1: # d197_rule.tsv — D197's DECISION RULE for the mfcard window, DECLARED BEFORE ANY NUMBER EXISTS (review 2026-11-15 r5
# memfn-mfindcomb FIDELITY-4, as ruled, with the kit manager's R1 of 2026-11-15 (main's conditions); lane mcfixa).
# D197: the fused inline one-member finder is an unpicked measuring instrument; the timing is ONE-SIDED: a fused
# LOSS to libc memchr settles span_pick row 1 against the finder, a fused WIN triggers building the ruled split
# shape under its own owner go (then a re-measure).
# THE TIMED SHAPE IS INLINE, AS PCREC EMITS IT: each cell's timed function `_time` holds the finder's ONE call site
# with the site inlined (the gate is a separate object; link.py's TIMED-SHAPE check refuses a `_time` calling a
# function its own object defines), as in pcrec's rx_search under `--harness=mfind` (review r5 FIDELITY-1).
# ONE VERDICT PER ISA LEVEL, never one global verdict (R1 (1)). Each `levels` row names the form a pcrec build AT
# THAT LEVEL emits under the lever, CONFIRMED from the kit's selection (lane mcfixa, 2026-11-15, build/pcrec-harness
# --harness=mfind -p rx --pattern 'xy[0-9]+z' and 'foo.*bar': no -fmemfn-simd -> the SWAR body `fn-mfind` = cell
# form mfind-swar (4 `memcpy(&w` loads with the lever, 0 without; stamp `none`, the stamp names SIMD forms only);
# tail)), compared with libc memchr AS IT RUNS ON THIS BOX: the shipped arm (RUNDIR; the record names the ifunc
# variant bound, `memchr=`) and the AVX2-tunable arm (RUNDIR.avx2libc; its record must name memchr=avx2) as the
# second libc row. Each row's `axes` names EVERY axis on which its two forms differ (the standing one-variable rule).
# Read by d197_rule.py (`rule RUNDIR AVX2RUNDIR [--second]`, `drill`). Tables are FIRST MATCH, top to bottom; the
# `when` words are the named predicates d197_rule.py defines (WHEN, one line each), nothing else.
# STATISTIC (R1 (2)), est.py's units: a find_hit@6 row's x_l = its PER-HIT cost (the cell minus its own miss-only
# base, over the planted hits E: the per-hit slope of cost over hits at fixed length) in ppm of the window's unit W,
# per launch l (7 launches). Per deciding cell, the level's form F against libc L in the SAME record:
#   gain_l  = x_l(L) - x_l(F), the same job, launch and cell (positive: F is cheaper per hit)
#   gain    = med over the 7 launches of gain_l
#   floor   = aa(L) + aa(F), each row's paired A/A (est.py's `aa`: med_l |x_l(twin) - x_l(arm)|): THE A/A FLOOR
#   trimmed = the 7 gain_l less the one farthest from their median (est.py's trim)
# The SCAN cost (find_byte@6, JMB's miss-only per-byte slope of F and L) is REPORTED beside each level, never decides.
# The emitted size (EMITTED-1: the lever text 2.9x-6x fn-memchr's body) is reported by est.py rows, never decides.
